articles.title: Poll: Cracks emerge in GOP support for Trump and his handling of the Iran war - NBC News
articles.description: President Donald Trump’s pool of most ardent supporters is shrinking, according to a new poll, as Americans give him low marks on his overall job performance and his handling of the Iran war.
